about: What each NPC host event does in the world (S6; C08: it was a table in the code; schema 2, VILLAGE_PLAN V02). The core's agents raise the events; an event not listed changes nothing. action is give_item (an item by its stable name, and a count: a number, or qty for the number the learner said, capped at 5), point_at_noun (the beacon goes to the nearest block of a catalogue noun), point_at_place (to a named place of the scene) or point_at_slot (to the place a slot of the learner's line names, through the scene's labels: villager.point answers "¿dónde está el río?" and any other place; a place the scene does not have is answered by <npc>.unknown_place).
